flavor: A vast, circular chamber where the ceiling has collapsed into a perfect aperture. Shafts of solid, unyielding sunlight pierce the gloom, illuminating a mountain of bleached bones that shimmer with a pale, pearlescent luster.
name: The Gilded Ossuary of Noon
reason: The central curio is a collection of ancestral remains that have been transmuted into crystalline structures by concentrated solar exposure.
